author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner list treats a page number below one as the first page
summary: Requesting the owner list with a page number of zero or below currently shows the error page. The owner list must answer such a request exactly as it answers a request for the first page, with the normal listing.
acceptance_criteria: given the owner list requested with page 0, when the response returns, then it is HTTP 200 and shows the normal owner listing, not the error page
given the owner list requested with a negative page number, when the response returns, then it is HTTP 200 and shows the normal owner listing, not the error page
given a page number below one, when the owner list is requested, then the owners shown and the current page indicated are the same as for a request for page 1
non_goals: page values that are not whole numbers
page numbers beyond the last page
notes: Owner quote (intake line 1): 'the owner listing treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal listing (HTTP 200).' One data-driven test covers page 0 and a negative page. The three non_goals are deliberate omissions from this slice, not declined scope: the intake quotes nothing on them, and this slice does not depend on them. Each can be raised as its own request.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by architecture-principles.md § pattern catalog, Web controller row: normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, not a business rule, so the clamp belongs in OwnerController (system-design.md § Contracts, OwnerController row, now citing REQ-OWN-005). Cause (grep-verified, oracle not connected): processFindForm binds `page` with default 1 and findPaginatedForOwnersLastName passes `page - 1` to PageRequest.of, which rejects a negative index; page 0 and below therefore throw and reach the error page. testing-principles.md § Test Pyramid places controller normalization at the web level, so the test stays in OwnerControllerTests.
integration_points: Entry point GET /owners (existing, no new entry point): binding target unchanged, the request-scoped `page` int parameter plus the existing Owner search form object; normalize `page` to at least 1 once, at handler entry, and use the normalized value for both the repository PageRequest and the `currentPage` model attribute

Repository boundary (OwnerRepository): reuse the existing @MockitoBean `owners` field in OwnerControllerTests, the one framework stub the class already carries. Reason: OwnerRepository extends JpaRepository, so a hand-written double would implement that whole surface, and a real repository would take the test out of the @WebMvcTest slice the PRD targets. Stub findByLastNameStartingWith to return a multi-owner page and assert the Pageable reaching it has page number 0
Transport boundary: MockMvc, the sanctioned web-layer harness (testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy)

patterns.description: existing multi-input web test for owner search normalization (whitespace stripping); follow its shape for the data-driven page 0 / negative page cases

risks.risk: The model's currentPage keeps the raw sub-one value while the query uses page 1, so the pager renders no current page and breaks AC3
risks.mitigation: Normalize once and pass the normalized value to both findPaginatedForOwnersLastName and addPaginationModel; assert model attribute currentPage == 1 (architecture-principles.md § pattern catalog, Web controller row: binding owns the parameter's range)

risks.risk: An extreme negative value such as Integer.MIN_VALUE overflows if the clamp is written as arithmetic
risks.mitigation: Clamp with Math.max(page, 1) before any subtraction, the simplest readable form

risks.risk: Owner list query path scales with owner count; system-design.md has no § Scale and Load section, so no row exists to cite
risks.mitigation: The slice adds no data-scaling path: the query is pre-existing and bounded by the fixed controller page size (system-design.md § Constants note). Treat it as bounded; simplest readable form

notes: No design-doc-autofix records to audit. Out of scope per prd-entry non_goals: non-integer page values (these stay a binding error), pages beyond the last page, and VetController paging, which carries the same PageRequest.of(page - 1) shape and is left untouched. Brief gap for a later slice: system-design.md has no § Scale and Load section, although the design-validation checklist expects one; this slice does not need it.

semantic_surprise.note: Math.max(page, 1) runs before the page - 1 subtraction at OwnerController.java:138, so Integer.MIN_VALUE cannot overflow.
